cards.public_summary: Jalen Hurts has thrown 13 interceptions across 16 Eagles practices, after totaling 15 over the prior four training camps combined.
cards.evidence:
Eagles Training Camp Day 16 Takeaways:

Jalen Hurts has 13 interceptions in 16 practices this year

Hurts had 15 interceptions the last four training camps combined 

Hurts and offense are turning it over way too much —  and if it keeps up in the regular season they both will and should revert back to the old style of being conservative in the passing game (the style that won them a Super Bowl)
cards.commentary: The unusually high camp turnover total is a negative signal for Hurts' passing efficiency if it persists, though practice interceptions do not establish regular-season performance or a role change.
cards.author: EliotShorrParks
